intent.problem: Safe-output implementations may violate documented privilege, validation, authorization, content, protocol, configuration, execution, and cache guarantees. Such failures must be independently observable and actionable.
intent.sourceGoal: Run the native checker, analyze critical/high/medium/low findings, and make genuine conformance issues visible and actionable for follow-up.
intent.outcome: For eligible native checker conditions, advance actual conformance by clearing independently reproduced diagnostic conditions, measured as distinct conditions cleared per non-overlapping seven-day period.
intent.observablePartialFacet: Immutable repository bytes independently satisfy an unchanged native checker predicate that failed at the preceding cutoff. This is partial structural progress, not behavioral conformance.
intent.fullAcceptance: All normative specification requirements, runtime behavior, adversarial cases, target authorization, and relevant regression tests must independently pass before asserting complete conformance.
intent.visibilityVsOutcome: An issue or report is a discovery artifact; even an actionable report does not prove its claim or subsequent remediation.

sourceReview.currentWorkflow: Complete frozen source and all transitive imports preserved in the closure.
sourceReview.checker: All 2515 lines, every function and all 55 named rule families reviewed. Its text predicates are structural heuristics, not general semantic program analysis.
sourceReview.specification: The complete source is preserved losslessly. Normative requirement inventory spans conformance classes, security architecture, components, configuration, universal features, every type, protocol, content integrity, execution, cache integrity and appendices.
sourceReview.specificationReview: Complete current/adoption specification prose, examples, schemas and exemptions subsequently reviewed by one isolated source-only agent, without outcome access. source-review.json records verified source identities, complete contiguous line coverage and all 55 rule reconciliations: twenty partial, thirty-five unimplemented.
sourceReview.reviewChronology: The initial v1 candidate was sealed before the full specification review was finished and is not represented as fully reviewed ex ante. Source-only review preceded v2 correction. The v2 surviving-file correction addresses SRC-12 without changing the sealed original instrument or tuning from observed results.
sourceReview.remainingSourceReviewLimits: References to external implementation/tests/formal models were not independently fetched or verified. Compiled workflow context was reviewed selectively, not every generated job/script. Sixteen source-cited ambiguities/corrections are recorded, not silently resolved as conformance.
nativePitfalls: SEC-001 and REQ-002 increment counters inside piped while subshells; summary counters can disagree with emitted failures.
Adoption log counters use post-increment under set -e; the first zero-valued counter increment can terminate execution before completion.
head/grep pipelines with pipefail may terminate checks early. Partial output or exit zero cannot establish complete conformance.
SEC-002 native awk checks lexical line ordering, not control-flow dominance. A pattern in comments can satisfy text predicates.
REQ-002 checks only the first ten documented types and a 200-line context; it is not exhaustive specification validation.
Current SEC-004 and SEC-005 support exemption annotations. Suppressed raw burden must survive separately; a new exemption is not remediation.

Current and adoption scopes differ substantially. This instrument pins the reviewed current predicates and labels historical replay retrospective; it never attributes differences to workflow adoption.

scope.repositoryAuthority: One public repository, exact numeric identity. No policy, dispatch, permission or credential changes.
scope.discovery: Every surviving matching issue/PR in the shared digest-checked cursor archive, including unverified workflow IDs, retained without truncation.
scope.history: Six source cutoffs over 35 days. Earlier history and all unmatched requested windows remain missing.
scope.native: Whole native handler-loop inventory is traversed at each selected cutoff; available bytes are replayed and unavailable blobs are separately inventoried. All 55 check families remain in the ledger.
scope.coverage: Partial: twenty rule families have one or more replayed predicates, thirty-five remain unimplemented. Even those twenty are not full-rule behavioral verification.
unknown: 512 immutable source blobs absent in the authorized offline cache
Remaining native predicates and full specification obligations
Resolve source-cited specification/schema contradictions and implement remaining independent acceptance predicates
Independent test/check acceptance at candidate accepted revisions
Protected checker reports and production execution identity
Complete workflow-to-remediation lineage, original producer and later implementer
Deleted/transferred outputs, edited-away markers, comments and discussions

frozenAcceptance.period: Seven days, inclusive start and exclusive end; last immutable first-parent source state at each declared boundary
frozenAcceptance.matching: Same surviving identity fails before and passes after under the exact frozen instrument
frozenAcceptance.exclusions: New waiver, suppression, path deletion, lost eligibility, unreadable source, changed identity, merge alone and activity counts cannot establish clearance
frozenAcceptance.actorIndependence: Maintainer, other automation and workflow-supported fixes satisfy the same native predicate
frozenAcceptance.attribution: Separate metric; an independent graph/receipt join is required. Editable footer markers and related-number references are only candidates.
frozenAcceptance.missingRule: Positive demonstrated subtotals are retained as partial lower bounds. Empty partial scope is null, not zero. Missing evidence does not establish an all-clear or a trend.
frozenAcceptance.decision: Not rated; no invented quality score, weights, target or keep threshold

antecedentTest.phenomenon: Pre-existing repository implementation conformance can exist without the workflow.
antecedentTest.formula: The same stable native condition can be tested before adoption without a workflow output.
antecedentTest.reconstruction: Bounded offline pre-adoption availability probe preserves two immutable cutoffs and complete tree metadata: 96/410 and 106/449 selected blobs available, 452 unique objects absent. No accepted comparable baseline is asserted. Source acquisition, fixed shared obligation-profile validation and historical producer evidence remain open.
antecedentTest.classification: Attainment-only reporting without a baseline or causal claim; this is not a claim of historical impossibility.

versionedCorrection.change: A fail-to-pass structural condition counts only when the same repository-relative file has available verified immutable bytes at both boundaries. Required-component creation is excluded, not silently treated as surviving-file remediation.
versionedCorrection.unchanged: Native predicates, original instrument bytes, metric units/roles/formulas, observation windows and accepted-evidence safeguards remain unchanged.
versionedCorrection.classification: Provisional attainment-only report mode is explicitly not an endorsed final historical classification; reconstructability remains open.

observedPartialOutcomes.clearanceExplanation: No independently cleared stable condition was established in the replayed subset; incomplete evidence does not establish zero total remediation.
